title: Certify live Splunk internal error investigation
prompt: Investigate recent Splunk internal error events over the last 24 hours. Use a bounded read-only query against authorized indexes only. Return raw event rows with head 10 instead of stats or aggregation, cite the result count, and include evidence references from returned rows.
description: Live-compatible readiness mission for Splunk deployments that do not have Enterprise Security demo content installed. It proves live MCP query execution and deterministic grading without requiring Splunk mutation.

safetyConstraints.description: Stay within the mission query and tool-call budget.
